name: add_stop
description: Add a stop to a day, or to ideas when dayId is "ideas". Pass placeId (from search_places) to add a real place, or name to add a placeholder. A placeholder inherits the previous stop's location and cannot be the first stop of a day, so add it at index >= 1 or after a real place. index is 0-based and clamped to the end of the list; omit it to append. Returns the full updated trip.

dayId.description: Id of the day to add the stop to, or "ideas" for the unscheduled stops.

placeId.description: Place id from search_places, for a real place.

name.description: Stop name. With placeId it overrides the place's default name; without placeId it creates a placeholder.

index.description: 0-based position within the day. Omit to append; values past the end are clamped to the end.

pinnedTime.description: Fixed start time, HH:mm local to the place. May run past midnight, up to 47:59. Send null to leave it unscheduled.

pinnedEndTime.description: Fixed end time, HH:mm local to the place. May run past midnight, up to 47:59. Send null to leave it unscheduled.

legMode.description: How you travel to this stop: auto, walk, drive, cycle or other. "auto" picks walking or driving; "other" is travel the app cannot compute.

notes.description: Free text for this stop, at most 2000 characters. Send null or an empty string to clear it.
